label: Whatever is MOTION_1 moved in some respect has its being caused by another
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: if y is being moved (MOTION_1) in some respect r, then something c distinct from y causes y's being (CausesIn c y esse, CAUSE_2). Classically it is the contrapositive of 'a being whose being nothing else causes is moved in no respect'; the positive form keeps the extension constructive. It is the complement that extends C* for caused movers (e3afc8a3-b51b-4f44-a093-ce27cf8e1f0a) to every moved mover (b3573a61-ec8b-5aba-8b5f-f1d03611e7f6). The 2026-11-17 esse-composition reasoning in docs/notes/prima-via-strength-consumers.md is proposed to supply its contrapositive from 4be9a4ac, d8024a38 and ca07cae9; that derivation is not registered. It is the premise that passes from the CAUSE_2 guard to MOTION_1 being moved, declared as the sense bridge of the extension.
